digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 39
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login
items.summary: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login for hosted sign-in pages. Existing password accounts can add a passkey from the profile page.
items.whyItMatters: Users can sign in without typing a password.

items.title: Larkin Router 3.8.2 speeds up route compilation
items.summary: Larkin Router 3.9.2 speeds up route compilation for large applications. Compiled routes are cached between restarts.
items.whyItMatters: Large applications start with less delay.

items.title: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore
items.summary: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore for managed clusters. Restores create a new cluster, so the original keeps running.
items.whyItMatters: Recovery no longer touches the running cluster.

sources.title: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login
sources.summary: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login for hosted sign-in pages. Existing password accounts can add a passkey from the profile page. Admins can require passkeys for chosen groups.

sources.title: Larkin Router 3.8.2 speeds up route compilation
sources.summary: Larkin Router 3.8.2 speeds up route compilation for large applications. Compiled routes are cached between restarts. The release also fixes a rare crash on empty paths.

sources.title: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore
sources.summary: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore for managed clusters. Restores create a new cluster, so the original keeps running. Restore history is listed in the console with the time range of each backup.
